title: Build tools follow the target version
text: Build-toolchain bumps follow the target automatically (AppleSkin needed Loom 1.10 + Gradle 8.13).
result: A Fabric port raises Loom to the newest release of the line its target dependencies were built with (from each jar's Fabric-Loom-Version), then raises the Gradle wrapper to the version that Loom's published metadata asks for. It never lowers either. AppleSkin 1.20.1 → 1.21.6: Loom 1.8-SNAPSHOT to 1.10.5 and Gradle 8.10 to 8.12, with no hand edit.
